properties.headline: Coastal Flood Advisory issued October 26 at 3:27PM PDT until October 27 at 3:00PM PDT by NWS Eureka CA
properties.description:
* WHAT...High astronomical tides will cause minor flooding in low
lying areas around Humboldt Bay. Up to one half foot of
saltwater inundation above ground level is possible near
shorelines and tidal waterways. Between 9.0 and 9.2 feet MLLW
at the North Spit tide gauge is predicted.

* WHERE...Northern Coastal Humboldt County.

* WHEN...From noon to 3 PM PDT Tuesday. High tide is at 12:34 PM
at the Humboldt Bay North Spit tide gauge. Saltwater inundation
will be possible 1 to 2 hours before and after high tide.

* IMPACTS...Flooding of low lying areas around Humboldt Bay
including parks and roads with only isolated closures
expected. Flooding will likely impact Jackson Ranch Road in
the Arcata Bottoms and several roads in King Salmon.
properties.instruction:
A Coastal Flood Advisory indicates that onshore winds and tides
will combine to generate flooding of low areas along the shore.

Feet Above Ground is locally defined as feet above the Highest
Astronomical Tide or HAT.

properties.areaDesc: San Diego County Coastal Areas; Orange County Coastal
properties.headline: Coastal Flood Warning issued October 26 at 1:55PM PDT until October 29 at 1:00PM PDT by NWS San Diego CA
properties.description:
* WHAT...Significant coastal flooding expected.

* WHERE...San Diego County coastal areas and Orange County
Coastal Areas.

* WHEN...Until 1 PM PDT Thursday during high tides in the late
mornings.

* IMPACTS...Numerous roads may be closed. Low lying property
including homes, businesses, and some critical infrastructure
will be inundated. Some shoreline erosion will occur in the
late mornings.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Coastal residents and managers of
infrastructure in the warned area should prepare for rising
water and take appropriate action to protect life and
property. High tides each day will occur in the late morning.
Observed high tides are 1.5 to 1.7 feet above astronomical
tide predictions.
properties.instruction:
Take the necessary actions to protect flood-prone property. If
travel is required, do not drive around barricades or through
water of unknown depth. Stay off of jetties and sea walls. Avoid
beaches during high tides. During high and rising tides, waves
may run farther up the beach than expected. Stay far back from the
water and never turn your back on the ocean.

properties.headline: Coastal Flood Advisory issued October 26 at 11:04AM PDT until October 29 at 3:00PM PDT by NWS San Francisco CA
properties.description:
* WHAT...Up to 2.1 ft of inundation above ground level is
possible in low-lying areas near shorelines and tidal waterways.

* WHERE...Bay Shoreline locations of San Pablo Bay, San
Francisco Bay, and Monterey Bay.

* WHEN...Until 3 PM PDT Thursday.

* IMPACTS...High tides will result in flooding of low-lying
infrastructure, isolated road closures, and coastal erosion.
Rising tides will bring water and waves farther up the beach
than normal, restricting escape from beaches and coastal
areas. More substantial impacts are expected along bayshore
Marin County where increased flooding is anticipated across
low lying areas.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...At the San Francisco tidal gauge, high
tide is expected to be 2.0 ft above normal (7.8 ft MLLW) at
11:39 AM Monday 10/26, 2.1 ft above normal (7.9 ft MLLW) at
12:15 PM Tuesday 10/27, 1.9 ft above normal (7.7 ft MLLW) at
12:56 PM Wednesday 10/28, and 1.7 ft above normal (7.5 ft
MLLW) at 01:43 PM Thursday 10/29. These predictions include up
to 1.0 ft of surge that will enhance the astronomical tide and
flooding threat. High tide varies up to 90 minutes earlier or
later along the Pacific Coast and through the San Francisco
Bay, respectively.
properties.instruction:
If travel is required, allow extra time as some roads may be
closed. Do not drive around barricades or through water of
unknown depth. Take the necessary actions to protect flood-prone
property.

properties.areaDesc: San Luis Obispo County Beaches; Santa Barbara County Central Coast Beaches; Santa Barbara County Southwestern Coast; Santa Barbara County Southeastern Coast; Ventura County Beaches; Malibu Coast; Los Angeles County Beaches
properties.headline: Coastal Flood Advisory issued October 26 at 10:00AM PDT until October 29 at 1:00PM PDT by NWS Los Angeles/Oxnard CA
properties.description:
* WHAT...Minor to moderate coastal flooding expected due to very
high tides.

* WHERE...San Luis Obispo County Beaches, Santa Barbara County
Central Coast Beaches, Santa Barbara County Southwestern
Coast, Santa Barbara County Southeastern Coast, Ventura County
Beaches, Malibu Coast and Los Angeles County Beaches.

* WHEN...Until 1 PM PDT Thursday.

* IMPACTS...Minor to moderate flooding of sea water is likely
over vulnerable low-lying coastal areas, especially around the
time of high tide, including over beach parking lots, bike
paths, and harbor walkways. Moderate to significant beach
erosion is likely. Isolated damage of structures due to sea
water inundation is possible to the most vulnerable areas.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...High tides will likely reach 7.5-8.0 feet
(MLLW) each late morning, which is 1.0 to 1.5 feet above
astronomical projections. The highest tides will be Monday
through Wednesday. There is a small chance for isolated Coastal
Flood Warnings Wednesday through Thursday if larger surf
develops. The Coastal Flood Advisory may also need to be
extended beyond Thursday.
properties.instruction:
Take the necessary actions to protect flood-prone property. Do
NOT drive around barricades or through water of unknown depth.
